_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: The model and the system prompt are grouped into one context card. The window starts 1000x800. The conversation /c/{{SLUG}} was started with "echo: context card". "The card" is the element with data-testid "generation-context"; "the model bar" is '[data-testid="generation-context"] > .model-bar' (a direct child). window.__promptButton() is the card's button whose name contains "System Prompt:" (role "button" with that name, within the card, picks the same one), and window.__promptText() its rendered text (innerText, which has the screen-reader "Expand" or "Collapse" on a line of its own) with whitespace collapsed. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. The element with data-testid "message-input" should be visible (allow 30s). 3. The card should be visible; so should the model bar. There must be exactly 1 '[data-testid="generation-context"] > .system-prompt-view' (it is display: contents, with no box of its own to be visible; the prompt button inside it shows). 4. The prompt button should be visible, and eval /System Prompt:\s*\d+ tools?\s*,?\s*\d+ skills? Expand/.test(window.__promptText()) must return true. The screen-reader text must be part of its accessible name too: the card's button named "Expand" (role "button" with that name, within the card) should be visible. 5. The model bar should contain "Model:". 6. The model bar must not contain "Reasoning" (assert_text_not_contains). 7. Eval /System Prompt:\s*\d+ tools?,\s*\d+ skills?/.test(window.__promptText()): true. 8. Eval (() => { const cs = getComputedStyle(window.__promptButton()); return cs.boxShadow + ' ' + cs.borderLeftWidth; })(): exactly "none 0px". 9. In one eval without "expect", make the model name very long: document.querySelector('[data-testid="generation-context"] > .model-bar .model-bar-name').textContent = 'a-very-long-custom-model-name-'.repeat(12). 10. Eval (() => { const card = window.__card().getBoundingClientRect(); const p = window.__promptButton().getBoundingClientRect(); return p.width > 200 && p.right <= card.right + 1; })(): true. 11. The long name ellipsizes: eval (() => { const e = document.querySelector('[data-testid="generation-context"] > .model-bar .model-bar-name'); return e.scrollWidth > e.clientWidth; })(): true. 12. The ", <reasoning>" after it stays fully visible, clipped by no ancestor: eval (() => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-testid="generation-context"] > .model-bar .model-bar-reasoning'); const range = document.createRange(); range.selectNodeContents(el); const r = range.getBoundingClientRect(); const y = r.top + r.height / 2; return JSON.stringify([r.left + 1, r.right - 1].map((x) => document.elementFromPoint(x, y) === el)); })(): exactly "[true,true]". 13. The model bar and the prompt button share a line: eval (() => { const m = document.querySelector('[data-testid="generation-context"] > .model-bar').getBoundingClientRect(); const p = window.__promptButton().getBoundingClientRect(); return Math.abs(m.top - p.top) < 1 && Math.abs(m.bottom - p.bottom) < 1; })(): true. 14. Set the viewport to 540x800 (set_viewport). 15. The prompt button should be visible. 16. In one eval without "expect", record window.__skills = Number(window.__promptText().match(/(\d+) skills?/)[1]) and window.__tools = Number(window.__promptText().match(/(\d+) tools?/)[1]). 17. Eval window.__skills > 0 && window.__tools > 0: true. 18. Click the prompt button (role "button" named "System Prompt:" within the card). 19. Eval /System Prompt:\s*\d+ tools?\s*,?\s*\d+ skills? Collapse/.test(window.__promptText()) until it returns true, and the card's button named "Collapse" (role "button" with that name, within the card) should be visible. 20. The card's ".system-prompt-content" should be visible. 21. Eval window.__card().querySelectorAll('.system-prompt-skill-item').length === window.__skills && window.__card().querySelectorAll('.system-prompt-tool-item').length === window.__tools: true. 22. "The skill card" is the card's ".system-prompt-skill-item" whose ".system-prompt-card-name" reads exactly "commit-highlights" (a built-in skill; integration skills may come first, so pick it by name; use "within" with has_text "commit-highlights"). Click its ".system-prompt-card-summary". 23. Its ".system-prompt-card-detail" should be visible and contain "Source". 24. The first "code" element in its ".system-prompt-card-detail" should contain "SKILL.md". 25. "The tool card" is the card's first ".system-prompt-tool-item". Click its ".system-prompt-card-summary". 26. Its ".system-prompt-card-detail" should be visible and contain "Source". 27. The first "code" element in its ".system-prompt-card-detail" should contain "claudetool/". 28. The card's two rows draw no surface of their own: eval JSON.stringify([...window.__card().querySelectorAll(':scope > .model-bar, :scope > .system-prompt-view')].map((e) => { const s = getComputedStyle(e); return [s.backgroundColor, s.borderTopWidth, s.borderRightWidth, s.borderBottomWidth, s.borderLeftWidth].join(' '); })), which must return exactly "[\"rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px\",\"rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px\"]".
